# Hamsa unit economics (generated by cost_model.py)

All ₹ figures exclude GST. Values marked HYPOTHESIS in `cost_model.py` must be replaced by measurements from the Phase 3 serving benchmark and Phase 7 voice benchmark.

## Cost per AI-handled text conversation

- Conversation = 6 customer messages; LLM-free share target = 50% (edge 20%, intent/template 20%, semantic cache 10%); Hamsa-LM 47%; large fallback 3%.
- One Hamsa-LM call: ₹0.0069 on L40S (E2E Networks on-demand) at 40% utilisation.
- One large-model fallback call: ₹0.1320.

| component | ₹ per conversation |
|---|---:|
| small_llm | 0.0196 |
| large_llm | 0.0238 |
| retrieval | 0.0029 |
| platform | 0.0150 |
| total | 0.0612 |

| component | web voice ₹/min | phone (SIP/PSTN) ₹/min |

| tts | 0.1195 | 0.1195 |

## Sensitivity: ₹99 plan at 100% of allowance

| scenario | ₹ per conversation | gross margin |
|---|---:|---:|
| baseline | 0.0612 | 58% |
| cascade fails: 80% of msgs hit Hamsa-LM | 0.0922 | 49% |
| large fallback 10% instead of 3% | 0.1137 | 42% |
| throughput 3x worse than hypothesis | 0.1004 | 44% |
| GPU utilisation 15% | 0.0938 | 46% |
| no prefix caching | 0.0772 | 52% |
| IndiaAI reserved L40S | 0.0503 | 62% |

## Verified price inputs

- GPU prices: L40S (IndiaAI on-demand): ₹67.5/h — compute.indiaai.gov.in price calculator, Mar 2026
- GPU prices: L40S (IndiaAI 12-month reserved): ₹45.0/h — compute.indiaai.gov.in price calculator, Mar 2026
- GPU prices: L40S (E2E Networks on-demand): ₹102.0/h — e2enetworks.com/gpus/nvidia-l40s, Oct 2026
- GPU prices: H100 (cheapest Indian on-demand): ₹192.48/h — maapan.ai/prices/h100, 6 Sep 2026
- WhatsApp India rates: Meta rate card effective 1 Oct 2026: marketing ₹0.8631, utility/auth/service ₹0.1150, first 1,000 service messages per number per month free
- UPI MDR: Zero MDR for P2M <= ₹2,000 and for P2PM small merchants <= ₹1 lakh/month via QR; 0.4% above ₹2,000 from 15 Oct 2026 (PIB)
